YEAR 670 OF THE AMBER STAR + 4 YEARS AFTER THE CATACLYSM OF JOY

THE CITY OF FRANQLINE + WHERE GOD'S LOVE NO LONGER LIVES

The plane of demons has merged with that of the earthborn people, and after four years of post-apocalyptic rebuilding, tensions are reaching another peak.

琥珀星曆670年＋歡愉大災變後第四年

弗蘭克林城＋神之愛已不再棲居之所

惡魔的位面已與地上居民的位面融合。末日之後歷經四年重建，雙方的關係正再度緊張到極點。
